title: Symbol-U Pricing and Subscription Tiers
content:
Symbol-U offers flexible pricing to match your organization's needs:

**Subscription Tiers:**

1. **Starter** ($499/month)
   - Up to 10 users
   - Explorer tier access only
   - 100K tokens/month
   - Email support
   - Basic analytics

2. **Professional** ($1,999/month)
   - Up to 50 users
   - Explorer + Analyst tiers
   - 500K tokens/month
   - Priority support
   - Advanced analytics + exports

3. **Enterprise** (Custom pricing)
   - Unlimited users
   - All tiers including Developer
   - Custom token allocation
   - Dedicated success manager
   - SLA guarantees
   - On-premise deployment option
   - Custom integrations

**Add-ons:**
- Additional tokens: $10 per 10K tokens
- SSO integration: $200/month
- Custom domain: $100/month
- Audit log retention (extended): $150/month

**Billing:**
- Annual contracts receive 20% discount
- Invoicing available for Enterprise tier
- All prices in USD
